title: Crystal Clear Bar Salts Blue Razz Lemonade Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Crystal Clear Blue Razz Lemonade Nic Salt pairs zingy Blue Raspberry with sparkling Lemonade for a vibrant fruit-fizz vape. The Blue Razz flavour offers bright, tangy berry notes, softened by a fizzy citrus twist. It's a lively, sweet-sour blend that delivers refreshment with every puff. Formulated at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this Nic Salt e-liquid is ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits , refillable vapes , and vape pens . Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths for a smooth draw and fast nicotine satisfaction. Crystal Clear Nic Salts are crafted to deliver the same great-tasting flavours that made disposable vapes so popular, now reimagined for refillable pod kits. Designed for clarity, consistency and convenience, this UK-made range focuses on fruity, icy, and confectionery-inspired blends that cater to everyday vapers.
